name: Stormbringer: Aeromancy and Storm Bond proc off the Air Elemental (#950, #1155)
contract: #950 Aeromancy (705708) and #1155 Storm Bond (500580) are both SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL passives that ship ProcFlags = 0 in Spell.dbc, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs builds no proc entry for them and nothing downstream ever runs. Aeromancy should make the Air Elemental repeat Updraft: 705708 triggers 707544 (SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST on TARGET_UNIT_PET), which makes the pet cast 707545, whose TARGET_DEST_DEST trigger casts Updraft 802354 at the pet. Storm Bond should turn the Air Elemental's damage into Static for its master: 500580 puts a proc aura on the summon (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS), the pet's proc casts 807463, whose SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST on TARGET_UNIT_MASTER makes the Stormbringer cast 807650, which adds EffectMiscValue[0] = 2 stacks of Static (803102). Only the two missing spell_proc rows are added; every other link is native.
